reason: The free audit is tempting, but it means sending open PO lines, jobs and supplier date history from our Epicor system to a startup, and that needs IT and security sign-off that won't happen within 30 days. I've also been burned by consultants who told me what my planners already knew, so I'd need proof it finds something new before I push it through.
objection: Even sanitized, supplier names, part numbers and job dates are sensitive, and 'read-only, offline' is a promise I can't verify without a security review of where the files go and how long they're kept.
would_change_my_mind: A written security summary (data handling, storage location, retention, deletion) that my IT and security team can approve quickly, plus a sample of the findings showing a supplier date change my team missed.
